title: Full Body + French Contrast
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Reverse Lunge × 6/side · Inchworm Shoulder Tap × 6 · 4 Way Deadbug × 8
jumps: Goblet Squat 3 → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Goblet @ RPE 8 · light DBs on the jump · max intent · rest 3:00

cond.subtitle: 5 rounds · new station every minute
items: Min 3: 20 yd Sled Push + walk back
cond.scaling: Sled taken? 40 yd Farmer's Carry · keep 15 sec rest

note: Heavy first, then fast. Take the full 3:00 between contrast rounds.
